fields.label: Status Indicator
fields.description: Colored circular indicator reflecting the current connection status.

fields.label: Instance Name
fields.description: Auto-generated as the site prefix followed by 5 random digits (e.g. samad-48291).

fields.label: Evolution Server
fields.description: Evolution API server that hosts this instance.

fields.label: Phone Number
fields.description: WhatsApp phone number in international format, e.g. 9665XXXXXXXX.

fields.label: Connection Status
fields.description: Live connection state, fetched automatically from the Evolution API. Cannot be edited manually.

fields.label: Connected Since
fields.description: Timestamp of the last successful connection.

fields.label: Linked User
fields.description: The user who owns this instance. A user may own at most one instance.

fields.label: Instance API Key
fields.description: Per-instance API key returned by the Evolution API. Visible to System Manager only.
